approved_task_config.title: Filtered localization systems of distinguished triangles and cofinality of component functors

standard_prerequisites.name: Calculus of fractions for a saturated multiplicative system
standard_prerequisites.statement: Ore completion, common-denominator equalization, filtered categories X/S, and equality in localization after postcomposition by an S-map. Saturation says any map inverted by localization lies in S.
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Categories tags05Q0 and05Q9; these are standard calculus-of-fractions inputs, not triangle coherence.

standard_prerequisites.name: Pre-triangulated rotation and compatibility MS5/MS6
standard_prerequisites.statement: S is stable under shift; every commutative square between first two entries of distinguished triangles with both maps in S admits a third S-map completing the triangle morphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: Filtered categories and cofinal functors
standard_prerequisites.statement: Filtered means nonempty, common upper targets and equalization of parallel arrows; cofinal means each target receives an arrow and the corresponding comma categories are connected.

core_obligations: Build common target triangles by successively completing all three legs, then use equality in the localization and further S-replacements to make the three squares commute simultaneously.
Equalize parallel triangle morphisms without destroying the three-leg structure, and lift a componentwise equalization to prove cofinality of each component functor.

proof_roadmap.step: Lift objects and arrows, synchronize three components by common denominators, then establish filteredness and cofinality.
